teamNotes: Both medals are team results: the gold medal is on a five-account Nemotron entry and the silver medal on a five-account Code Golf entry. Neither should be credited to him as an individual honour.

Kaggle's profile list does not show team names. The name Domdolus Tolus, carried in the people record for the Nemotron write-up and the ARC rosters, was not visible on either page read here and is not asserted in this file.

The four other accounts beside him on the Nemotron entry and on both active ARC Prize 2026 entries are rinnnntt, alwintheodoric, yassirramadhan and billyanggara. Code Golf shows jiweiliu, yiheng, cdeotte and tonylica beside him.
